sources.snippet: hima-tts-nano-hi-ONNX hima-tts-nano-hi (Hindi text to speech, 62M parameters) converted to ONNX, for fast speech on any CPU (Windows, Linux, Mac), with no PyTorch. Same voices, same sound; int8 is smaller and faster, and read just as clearly in our checks.

sources.snippet: hima-tts-nano-hi Hindi text to speech in a small model (62M parameters). It runs on a laptop CPU, faster than real time, and there are ONNX and MLX versions for even faster local use.
